name: London Potters
title:
A familiar website.
A new foundation.
intro: A closer look at the London Potters website and its EmDash demonstration. Five pages, the same design and addresses, rebuilt on a different platform.

labels.statusDetail: Demonstration for discussion. No migration authorised.
labels.context: The after version is an EmDash demonstration built from a public archive of the website taken on 5 November 2026, not from the organisation's own database. Payments, bookings and member sign-in are inactive in it. This comparison does not establish client approval, an authorised migration or measured performance improvements.
labels.disclaimer: Demonstration for discussion. Not client approval or an authorised migration.

pages.label: Home
pages.heading: The same welcome, on a new foundation.
pages.summary: The homepage is the first test of the rebuild: the same photographs, the same reasons to join and the same routes onward.
pages.beforeNote: The slideshow and the reasons to join open the page beneath the London Potters header.
pages.afterNote: The same slideshow and list appear beneath a notice identifying the page as a migration experiment built from a public archive.

pages.label: Members gallery
pages.heading: Every maker still has a place.
pages.summary: The members gallery is the part of the website with the most content. The rebuild keeps the same search by name, discipline and area.
pages.beforeNote: Search and filter controls sit above a grid of members' work, each with a name and a short description.
pages.afterNote: The same controls and grid, with a count of archived profiles and a Show all link above the results. The profiles appear in a different order in this capture.

pages.label: Events
pages.heading: The next event, where members expect it.
pages.summary: The events list keeps its search, its list, month and day views and the next gathering at the top.
pages.beforeNote: The Private View for the Annual Members Exhibition leads the upcoming list, with its venue, time and a tickets link.
pages.afterNote: The same event leads the list. The tickets-remaining figure differs because the demonstration reflects the archive date; bookings are inactive in it.

pages.label: News
pages.heading: News reads as it always has.
pages.summary: News is a simple list of stories with photographs. It is shown here to confirm that ordinary pages carry over unchanged.
pages.beforeNote: The Raw & Refined exhibition story leads the page, with its photograph, summary and a Read more link.
pages.afterNote: The same story, photograph and summary lead the page, beneath the demonstration notice.

pages.label: Membership
pages.heading: The invitation to join is unchanged.
pages.summary: The membership page explains who can join and what members receive. Joining itself is not part of this demonstration.
pages.beforeNote: An introduction and a checklist of member benefits lead into the membership options.
pages.afterNote: The same introduction, benefits and options appear beneath the demonstration notice. Sign-up and payment are inactive in the demonstration.
